title: Resolving the Mobility-Equity-Emissions Trilemma: A Causal Machine Learning Framework for Dynamic Tolling Policy
abstract: arXiv:2610.33994v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a causal machine learning framework to integrate dynamic tolling for mobility, equity, and climate objectives, resolving a long-standing policy trilemma. Using Double Machine Learning, we estimate zone-type-specific treatment effects, showing that commercial zones yield nearly twice the delay reduction of residential zones. Our adaptive quota mechanism expands residential coverage 34-fold while preserving 93% of total delay savings and sustaining high return on investment. The framework delivers climate co-benefits, reducing emissions by 743.5 metric tons of CO2 (valued at 141 USD) via congestion-sensitive pricing under moderate traffic conditions with sensitivity bounds from 557.6 to 929.3 tons. Crucially, we uncover a policy-invariant toll range where performance remains robust across demand scenarios, simplifying implementation. translated_title: 破解出行-公平-排放三难困境：动态收费政策的因果机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个因果机器学习框架，将动态收费与出行、公平和气候目标相整合，以解决长期存在的政策三难困境。利用双重机器学习，我们估计了不同区域类型特有的处理效应，结果显示商业区带来的延误减少效果几乎是住宅区的两倍。我们的自适应配额机制将住宅区覆盖范围扩大了34倍，同时保留了93%的总延误节省，并保持了较高的投资回报率。该框架带来了气候协同效益，在中等交通状况下通过拥堵敏感定价减少了743.5公吨二氧化碳排放（价值141美元），敏感性区间为557.6至929.3公吨。至关重要的是，我们发现了一个政策不变收费区间，在该区间内政策在不同需求情景下均保持稳健表现，从而简化了实施。本研究揭示了此前未被识别的关键洞见，例如政策不变的收费区间。
tldr: 提出基于双重机器学习的因果机器学习框架，通过动态收费政策同时兼顾出行效率、公平与气候目标，发现自适应配额机制可将住宅区覆盖扩大34倍并保留93%的延误节省，且识别出一个跨需求情景均稳健有效的政策不变收费区间。
en_tdlr: A causal machine learning framework using Double Machine Learning integrates dynamic tolling to jointly achieve mobility, equity, and emissions goals, revealing a policy-invariant toll range that remains robust across demand scenarios.
